title: 1.6 How often my family does it
unit_outcome: Describe people and family, say what people do every day and how often, and ask about other people’s habits.
lesson_title: How often my family does it
sub_lesson_title: How often my family does it
goal: Say how often your parents and grandparents do something, with always, usually, sometimes and never before the verb (My grandmother always drinks tea.).
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 1.6 Parents and Grandparents: the family words return with how often each person does something. The one new grammar relationship is the frequency word between the person and the verb (My grandmother always drinks tea.), on A1+ 1.2's he/she -s and 1.3's runs in the park.
prerequisite: A1 1.6 father, mother, grandfather, grandmother; A1 1.9 Who ...?; A1 2.1 park; A1 5 tea and coffee; A1 3.10 my; A1+ 1.2 drinks; A1+ 1.3 runs; A1+ 1.4 the grandparents.
speaking_outcome: Place the frequency word before the verb in one smooth sentence (My father sometimes runs in the park.), with a clear -s on the verb. Do not require native-like speed.
